# Local AOT development build, with separate desktop and diagnostic entry points.
set(SIMS2_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated" CACHE PATH
    "Local Sims 2 code generated from the player's supported disc")
option(SIMS2_HOST_TESTS_ONLY "Build synthetic host checks without any game corpus" OFF)
if(SIMS2_HOST_TESTS_ONLY)
    set(SIMS2_REGISTRY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/empty_registry.cpp")
    set(SIMS2_AOT "")
else()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${SIMS2_GENERATED_DIR}/generated_registry.cpp")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Generate the Sims 2 corpus first; see profiles/sims2/README.md")
    endif()
    set(SIMS2_REGISTRY "${SIMS2_GENERATED_DIR}/generated_registry.cpp")
    file(GLOB SIMS2_AOT CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${SIMS2_GENERATED_DIR}/generated_unit_*.cpp")
endif()
set_source_files_properties(third_party/tiny_aes/aes.c PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CXX)
add_library(sims2_kernel STATIC host/startup_hle.cpp host/kernel/early_kernel.cpp
    host/umd/disc_image.cpp host/umd/umd_drive.cpp host/io/io_manager.cpp
    host/platform/documents.cpp host/text/shift_jis.cpp host/rtc/rtc.cpp host/kernel/fixed_pool.cpp
    host/modules/utility_modules.cpp host/modules/module_manager.cpp host/kernel/sync.cpp
    host/ge/ge.cpp host/gpu/ge_state.cpp host/display/display.cpp host/audio/audio.cpp host/sas/sas.cpp
    host/ctrl/controller.cpp host/font/native_font.cpp host/movie/mpeg.cpp host/kernel/interrupts.cpp
    host/movie/psmf_demuxer.cpp host/movie/avc_decoder.cpp host/movie/color.cpp host/audio/atrac_decoder.cpp
    host/utility/savedata_dialog.cpp host/save_data/savedata_store.cpp host/save_data/param_sfo.cpp
    host/save_data/savedata_crypto.cpp host/save_data/aes128.cpp third_party/tiny_aes/aes.c host/audio/atrac.cpp
    host/gpu/texture_decode.cpp host/kernel/volatile_memory.cpp host/display/framebuffer_pixels.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sims2_kernel PUBLIC psprecomp_core)
if(WIN32)
    set(_sims2_backend D3D11)
else()
    set(_sims2_backend VULKAN)
endif()
set(SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND "${_sims2_backend}" CACHE STRING "D3D11 or VULKAN")
set_property(CACHE SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND PROPERTY STRINGS D3D11 VULKAN)
if(NOT SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND MATCHES "^(D3D11|VULKAN)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND must be D3D11 or VULKAN")
endif()
if(NOT WIN32 AND SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "D3D11")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "D3D11 requires Windows; select VULKAN")
endif()
if(WIN32)
    set(SIMS2_SDL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/SDL3")
    add_library(sims2_sdl INTERFACE)
    target_include_directories(sims2_sdl INTERFACE "${SIMS2_SDL}/include")
    target_link_libraries(sims2_sdl INTERFACE "${SIMS2_SDL}/lib/x64/SDL3.lib")
    target_link_libraries(sims2_kernel PRIVATE gdi32)
    set(SIMS2_FFMPEG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/ffmpeg")
    target_include_directories(sims2_kernel PRIVATE "${SIMS2_FFMPEG}/include")
    target_compile_definitions(sims2_kernel PRIVATE SIMS2_HAS_FFMPEG=1)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_kernel PRIVATE "${SIMS2_FFMPEG}/lib/avcodec.lib" "${SIMS2_FFMPEG}/lib/avutil.lib")
    add_custom_target(sims2_codec_runtime ALL
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${SIMS2_FFMPEG}/bin/avcodec-61.dll" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${SIMS2_FFMPEG}/bin/avutil-59.dll" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>")
    add_custom_command(TARGET sims2_codec_runtime POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${SIMS2_SDL}/lib/x64/SDL3.dll" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>")
endif()
if(NOT WIN32)
    find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
    pkg_check_modules(SIMS2_FFMPEG REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libavcodec libavutil)
    target_compile_definitions(sims2_kernel PRIVATE SIMS2_HAS_FFMPEG=1)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_kernel PRIVATE PkgConfig::SIMS2_FFMPEG)
    pkg_check_modules(SIMS2_FONTS REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET freetype2 fontconfig)
    target_compile_definitions(sims2_kernel PRIVATE SIMS2_FREETYPE=1)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_kernel PRIVATE PkgConfig::SIMS2_FONTS)
    find_package(SDL3 3.4 QUIET CONFIG)
    if(NOT SDL3_FOUND)
        include(FetchContent)
        set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        FetchContent_Declare(sdl3
            URL https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.4.20/SDL3-3.4.20.tar.gz
            URL_HASH SHA256=f3bb06f55bed9557227a700af2ea62e49497ebdf58037732a731a5fb3ef8581f)
        FetchContent_MakeAvailable(sdl3)
    endif()
    add_library(sims2_sdl INTERFACE)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_sdl INTERFACE SDL3::SDL3)
endif()

target_include_directories(sims2_kernel PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host")
target_include_directories(sims2_kernel PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party")
option(SIMS2_TIMING_RESEARCH "Developer-only bounded render timing experiment, never for releases" OFF)
if(SIMS2_TIMING_RESEARCH)
    set_property(SOURCE host/main.cpp APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SIMS2_TIMING_RESEARCH=1)
endif()
add_executable(sims2_probe host/main.cpp
    "${SIMS2_REGISTRY}" ${SIMS2_AOT})
target_link_libraries(sims2_probe PRIVATE sims2_kernel)
if(SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "D3D11")
    add_dependencies(sims2_probe sims2_codec_runtime)
    add_library(sims2_renderer STATIC host/gpu/native_renderer.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_renderer PUBLIC sims2_kernel d3d11 d3dcompiler)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_probe PRIVATE sims2_renderer)
    set(SIMS2_IMGUI "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/imgui")
    add_library(sims2_imgui STATIC ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui.cpp ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui_draw.cpp
        ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui_tables.cpp ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui_widgets.cpp
        ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/backends/imgui_impl_win32.cpp ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/backends/imgui_impl_dx11.cpp)
    target_include_directories(sims2_imgui PUBLIC "${SIMS2_IMGUI}")
    target_link_libraries(sims2_imgui PRIVATE d3d11 d3dcompiler dwmapi)
    add_library(sims2_host_settings STATIC host/display/host_settings.cpp)
    target_include_directories(sims2_host_settings PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host")
    add_library(sims2_shell STATIC host/display/native_window.cpp host/display/settings_overlay.cpp host/display/output_surface.cpp
        host/audio/native_audio.cpp host/ctrl/native_gamepad.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_shell PRIVATE sims2_imgui sims2_renderer dxgi PUBLIC sims2_host_settings)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(sims2_shell PRIVATE /utf-8)
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(sims2_shell PRIVATE sims2_sdl PUBLIC sims2_kernel user32 gdi32 winmm)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_probe PRIVATE sims2_shell)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_probe PRIVATE user32 gdi32 winmm)
    add_executable(sims2 WIN32 host/desktop_main.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2 PRIVATE user32 shell32)
    add_dependencies(sims2 sims2_probe)
endif()
if(SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "VULKAN")
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    find_program(SIMS2_GLSLANG NAMES glslangValidator glslang
        HINTS "$ENV{VULKAN_SDK}/Bin" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/out/dependencies/glslang/bin" REQUIRED)
    set(_shader_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_shader_dir}")
    foreach(stage IN ITEMS vert frag)
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_shader_dir}/ge.${stage}.spv"
            COMMAND "${SIMS2_GLSLANG}" -V "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host/gpu/shaders/ge.${stage}" -o "${_shader_dir}/ge.${stage}.spv"
            DEPENDS "host/gpu/shaders/ge.${stage}" VERBATIM)
    endforeach()
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_shader_dir}/sims2_spirv.hpp"
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/embed_spirv.py"
            "${_shader_dir}/sims2_spirv.hpp" "${_shader_dir}/ge.vert.spv" "${_shader_dir}/ge.frag.spv"
        DEPENDS tools/embed_spirv.py "${_shader_dir}/ge.vert.spv" "${_shader_dir}/ge.frag.spv" VERBATIM)
    add_library(sims2_renderer STATIC host/gpu/vulkan_renderer.cpp "${_shader_dir}/sims2_spirv.hpp")
    target_include_directories(sims2_renderer PRIVATE "${_shader_dir}")
    target_compile_definitions(sims2_renderer PUBLIC SIMS2_VULKAN=1)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_renderer PUBLIC sims2_kernel sims2_sdl)
    set(SIMS2_IMGUI "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/imgui")
    add_library(sims2_imgui STATIC ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui.cpp ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui_draw.cpp
        ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui_tables.cpp ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/imgui_widgets.cpp
        ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/backends/imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp ${SIMS2_IMGUI}/backends/imgui_impl_sdlgpu3.cpp)
    target_include_directories(sims2_imgui PUBLIC "${SIMS2_IMGUI}")
    target_link_libraries(sims2_imgui PRIVATE sims2_sdl)
    add_library(sims2_host_settings STATIC host/display/host_settings.cpp)
    target_include_directories(sims2_host_settings PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host")
    add_library(sims2_shell STATIC host/display/sdl_window.cpp host/audio/native_audio.cpp host/ctrl/native_gamepad.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_shell PRIVATE sims2_imgui PUBLIC sims2_renderer sims2_sdl sims2_host_settings)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_probe PRIVATE sims2_shell)
    if(WIN32)
        add_dependencies(sims2_probe sims2_codec_runtime)
        add_executable(sims2 WIN32 host/desktop_main.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2 PRIVATE user32 shell32)
        add_dependencies(sims2 sims2_probe)
    else()
        add_executable(sims2 host/desktop_posix.cpp)
        add_dependencies(sims2 sims2_probe)
        set_target_properties(sims2_probe PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/lib")
        install(TARGETS sims2 sims2_probe RUNTIME DESTINATION . COMPONENT sims2)
        if(TARGET SDL3-shared)
            install(TARGETS SDL3-shared LIBRARY DESTINATION lib COMPONENT sims2)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT MSVC)
    # Huge generated functions make -O3 compilation unnecessarily expensive.
    target_compile_options(sims2_probe PRIVATE -O1)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    option(SIMS2_OPTIMIZE_AOT "Optimize generated Sims 2 units for interactive runs" ON)
    if(SIMS2_OPTIMIZE_AOT)
        # /O1 bounds MSVC's work on large generated functions while eliminating
        # the many temporary arrays retained by the diagnostic /Od build.
        target_compile_options(sims2_probe PRIVATE /bigobj /EHsc /MP4 /O1)
    else()
        target_compile_options(sims2_probe PRIVATE /bigobj /Od /EHsc /MP4)
    endif()
endif()
if(PSPRECOMP_BUILD_PROFILE_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    foreach(name IN ITEMS startup_hle early_kernel umd io rtc module sync ge ge_state display
                          fixed_pool module_manager priority audio sas ctrl interrupt mpeg color savedata savedata_dialog atrac texture_decode volatile_memory framebuffer_pixels)
        add_executable(sims2_${name}_tests tests/${name}_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_${name}_tests PRIVATE sims2_kernel)
        if(WIN32)
            add_dependencies(sims2_${name}_tests sims2_codec_runtime)
        endif()
        add_test(NAME sims2_${name} COMMAND sims2_${name}_tests)
    endforeach()
    if(SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "D3D11")
        find_package(Python3 QUIET COMPONENTS Interpreter)
        if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
            add_test(NAME sims2_setup_process COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/setup_process_tests.py")
            set_tests_properties(sims2_setup_process PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
        endif()
        add_executable(sims2_native_gamepad_tests tests/native_gamepad_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_native_gamepad_tests PRIVATE sims2_shell sims2_sdl)
        add_dependencies(sims2_native_gamepad_tests sims2_codec_runtime)
        add_test(NAME sims2_native_gamepad COMMAND sims2_native_gamepad_tests)
        add_executable(sims2_presentation_tests tests/presentation_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_presentation_tests PRIVATE sims2_shell sims2_renderer)
        add_test(NAME sims2_presentation COMMAND sims2_presentation_tests)
        add_executable(sims2_host_settings_tests tests/host_settings_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_host_settings_tests PRIVATE sims2_shell sims2_renderer sims2_imgui)
        add_dependencies(sims2_host_settings_tests sims2_codec_runtime)
        add_test(NAME sims2_host_settings COMMAND sims2_host_settings_tests)
        set_tests_properties(sims2_host_settings PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
        add_executable(sims2_widescreen_tests tests/widescreen_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_widescreen_tests PRIVATE sims2_renderer)
        add_test(NAME sims2_widescreen COMMAND sims2_widescreen_tests)
        add_executable(sims2_renderer_tests tests/renderer_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_renderer_tests PRIVATE sims2_renderer)
        add_test(NAME sims2_renderer COMMAND sims2_renderer_tests)
        foreach(scale IN ITEMS 2 4 8)
            add_test(NAME sims2_renderer_${scale}x COMMAND sims2_renderer_tests ${scale})
        endforeach()
        add_executable(sims2_native_audio_tests tests/native_audio_tests.cpp host/audio/native_audio.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_native_audio_tests PRIVATE sims2_kernel winmm sims2_sdl)
        add_test(NAME sims2_native_audio COMMAND sims2_native_audio_tests)
        add_executable(sims2_native_font_tests tests/native_font_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_native_font_tests PRIVATE sims2_kernel)
        add_test(NAME sims2_native_font COMMAND sims2_native_font_tests)
    endif()
endif()

if(PSPRECOMP_BUILD_PROFILE_TESTS AND SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "VULKAN")
    foreach(name IN ITEMS native_gamepad native_audio native_font widescreen)
        add_executable(sims2_${name}_tests tests/${name}_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(sims2_${name}_tests PRIVATE sims2_shell sims2_sdl)
        add_test(NAME sims2_${name} COMMAND sims2_${name}_tests)
    endforeach()
    add_executable(sims2_renderer_tests tests/renderer_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_renderer_tests PRIVATE sims2_renderer)
    add_test(NAME sims2_vulkan_renderer COMMAND sims2_renderer_tests)
    foreach(scale IN ITEMS 2 4 8)
        add_test(NAME sims2_vulkan_renderer_${scale}x COMMAND sims2_renderer_tests ${scale})
    endforeach()
endif()

if(PSPRECOMP_BUILD_PROFILE_TESTS AND SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "VULKAN")
    add_executable(sims2_sdl_window_tests tests/sdl_window_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_sdl_window_tests PRIVATE sims2_shell)
    add_test(NAME sims2_sdl_window COMMAND sims2_sdl_window_tests)
    set_tests_properties(sims2_sdl_window PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 20)
    set_tests_properties(sims2_sdl_window sims2_widescreen sims2_vulkan_renderer
        sims2_vulkan_renderer_2x sims2_vulkan_renderer_4x sims2_vulkan_renderer_8x
        PROPERTIES LABELS "gpu")
endif()

if(WIN32 AND PSPRECOMP_BUILD_PROFILE_TESTS AND SIMS2_GRAPHICS_BACKEND STREQUAL "VULKAN")
    foreach(target IN ITEMS sims2_renderer_tests sims2_sdl_window_tests sims2_native_audio_tests sims2_native_gamepad_tests)
        add_dependencies(${target} sims2_codec_runtime)
    endforeach()
endif()

if(PSPRECOMP_BUILD_PROFILE_TESTS)
    add_executable(sims2_codec_capabilities_tests tests/codec_capabilities_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_codec_capabilities_tests PRIVATE sims2_kernel)
    add_test(NAME sims2_codec_capabilities COMMAND sims2_codec_capabilities_tests)
    if(WIN32)
        add_dependencies(sims2_codec_capabilities_tests sims2_codec_runtime)
    endif()
    add_executable(sims2_frame_history_tests tests/frame_history_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(sims2_frame_history_tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host")
    add_test(NAME sims2_frame_history COMMAND sims2_frame_history_tests)
    add_executable(sims2_host_input_tests tests/host_input_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sims2_host_input_tests PRIVATE sims2_host_settings sims2_kernel)
    add_test(NAME sims2_host_input COMMAND sims2_host_input_tests)
endif()

if(PSPRECOMP_BUILD_PROFILE_TESTS)
    find_package(Python3 QUIET COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
        add_test(NAME sims2_prerequisites COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/doctor_tests.py")
        add_test(NAME sims2_launcher_settings COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/launcher_settings_tests.py" "$<TARGET_FILE:sims2_host_input_tests>")
        add_test(NAME sims2_benchmark_statistics COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/benchmark_tests.py")
    endif()
endif()
